$comment: PROPOSED declarative content fixtures; fictional narrative only, not executable Core API. Scheduling semantics aligned for feature development with coordinator ADR-C0-002 (PR #17); actual runtime DTO and integration remain pending.

instanceContract.instanceId: Core-owned stable unique ID per scheduled occurrence; distinct from reusable definitionId; persisted immutable and used as StableEventId
instanceContract.definitionId: Immutable content lookup key; multiple scheduled instances may reference one definition
instanceContract.priority: Core persists signed Int32 priority per occurrence; when definition omits priority Core assigns 0 once at scheduling time, never recalculates on load
instanceContract.receiptKey: Core-owned durable instanceId/resolutionKind; replay must not reapply effects
instanceContract.postingKey: Core ledger enforces unique earnedId and posting key after verified delivery; content only proposes income
instanceContract.queueOrdering: Core due outcomes: dueDayIndex ascending, priority descending, instanceId ascending (ordinal case-sensitive); neither phase nor creationOrdinal is a tie-break
instanceContract.dueSnapshot: Core freezes eligible due instances at start of due-outcomes stage after project ticks
instanceContract.sameDayChildren: During closing DayIndex n, new child with dueDayIndex <= n rejects entire prepared transaction atomically; persisted overdue instances remain eligible

notes: E02 and E03 share DayIndex=1; content does not assign priority, Core default 0 applies once at scheduling; stable instanceId breaks ties
E09 is presentation of Core settlement, not a second billing instruction
Conditional revenue requires actual delivery, not signature, and Core verifies eligibility before posting
Int64 wire amounts are decimal strings, not JSON numbers; runtime DTO adapter pending
ADR-C0-002 is approved for feature development only (PR #17); not merged, not a finalized runtime DTO
